note: Seasonings assumed to be at home when a recipe is filtered and revised. Edit this list (or point RECIPE_ASSUMED_SEASONINGS_FILE at another file); no code change is needed. 'mode': list = only these ids, all = every seasoning-labelled ingredient, none = nothing assumed. Source of the ten names: team decision D1 (2026-10-11), app/recipes/constants.py STAPLE_SEASONINGS. Water (204) is also always available regardless of this list. D1 spelled the pepper '후춧가루', the recipe table's ingredient is '후추' (554); '후춧가루' typed by a client is still read as 후추 through the synonym group in app/recipes/constants.py. 통후추 (504) and 흰후추 (560) are separate ingredients and are not included.
